_form_note: Verified against the production push workflow (form=Employee_Basic_Details, url=.../Integration/Employee/BasicDetails, api.gsb.government.ae) in the .ds export -- confidence is high. Same hardcoded institutionCode=141 pattern as the Applicants forms. Several picklists route through Deluge Dropdown_Fields functions (Gender, payroll, Campus, Equivalency_Indicator, Position_Title, Reason_why_Missing) that convert the Zoho display label back to a CHEDS code by NAME MATCH -- value_map below is built directly from those functions' code/name pairs, so it should match exactly. Email and Phone_Number are flagged 'personal data = true' in the form definition -- treat these raw columns with the same care you'd give any PII when building/reviewing import sheets.

fields._note: Raw HEDB code is converted to its descriptive Name using the 'Institutional Codes' reference list. Not used by the actual API push (institutionCode is hardcoded to 141) -- only populates the Zoho record for display.
Redundant with the code lookup above -- the Zoho form only has one institution field driven by the code. Intentionally not imported separately.
Raw HEDB code is converted to its descriptive Name using the 'Academic Period' reference list (this form's displayformat = [Name] only -- no combined Name-Code combo, unlike the Applicants forms).

No conversion applied -- value is imported exactly as provided in the raw file. Zoho enforces this as unique -- duplicate Employee IDs in your raw file will fail the import, which is a useful early catch.
No conversion applied. HEDB says to use 999999999999999 if not available -- worth a report-time warning if a row has this placeholder without a corresponding 'reason missing' value.

value_map.ONLINE: Distance Learning Student Or Faculty teaching online only (outside of UAE) or staff working remotely
value_map.NEW: New student/faculty and Emirates ID is applied for
value_map.MAR: Students with UAE passport but not UAE Nationals (Marsoom)
value_map.PRLW: Emirates ID cannot be provided as GDPR/FERPA and/or other privacy laws are applicable
value_map.DPL: Family of diplomats. Do not required emirates ID

fields._note: Raw short code is converted to the exact Zoho picklist text using a 7-entry table pulled from the Deluge Reason_why_Missing() dropdown function (e.g. 'GCC' -> 'GCC Resident with no Emirates ID'; 'VISITING' -> 'Visiting Student/Staff'; ...).

fields._note: Raw short code is converted to the exact Zoho picklist text: 'M' -> 'Male'; 'F' -> 'Female'; 'U' -> 'Unreported due to privacy laws applicable (e.g. GDPR , FERPA)'.
Raw short code is converted to the exact Zoho picklist text: 'U' -> 'University'; 'O' -> 'Outsourced'.

Date-time values are trimmed to a plain date (time portion removed) and written as yyyy-mm-dd.

No conversion applied. Marked 'personal data = true' in the Zoho form -- handle with normal PII care. HEDB says use xyz@xyz.com if not available.
